scope: Current desktop portal component coverage audit only; no implementation or visual parity claim.

reactApi.unit: Public React component exports, covering web and mobile together; not an upstream-completeness count.

statusDefinitions.exported-counterpart: An analogous reusable functional family is exported. This is NOT a claim of exhaustive upstream props, states, layout or behavioral parity.
statusDefinitions.partial: Only part of the source contract exists, or source subparts are integrated into another component.
statusDefinitions.example-only: Present in DesktopScreen demonstration markup, absent from the library public component API.
statusDefinitions.missing: No dedicated exported counterpart for the source unit.

counting.note: Do not sum MD/GDS/PrimeNG counts: generations overlap, subcomponent boundaries differ, and PrimeNG includes utilities/directives. PrimeNG availability alone is not a portal-widget inventory.
